what: Document fidelity over the dc-ifc set: every .xlsx, .xlsm and .xlsb under C:/Work/DnaCalc outside target, .git, node_modules and lock files, from the legacy repositories, OxFunc-Evidence and DnaTreeCalc, deduplicated by content hash (the 290 copies the exactness lane collected in C:/Work/DnaCalc/corpus/local-ifc; none is an .xlsb). Phase 1 is cargo xtask fidelity (calc-host open; unchanged save and reopen; edited save of one value and one formula reading it, recalculated, and reopen). Phase 2 is open-in-excel.ps1: each original, unchanged save and edited save opened in Excel with a normal load (CorruptLoad 0, which fails rather than repairs), one Excel at a time. Counts only; no workbook content.
notes: The 2 refusals by design are test fixtures built to be refused (a formula inside an array formula's area; array cell metadata that names no dynamic-array properties); Excel refuses both too.

The 8 opened workbooks Excel refuses as authored are hand-built test packages; each save Excel refuses is a workbook Excel refuses as authored. One (unreferenced bytes between ZIP entries) opens in Excel only after the save, which drops those bytes; it is also the one unchanged save not byte-equal to the original.
The 2 macro-sheet workbooks (an Excel 4.0 macro sheet among the sheets) are refused with a typed reason (Workbook/UnsupportedSheet); dc-xuw owns carrying such a sheet.
An .xlsb (made in Excel to try it) is refused with a typed reason (Workbook/NotASpreadsheet, the binary workbook content type); none is in the set, and dc-5sr owns reading one.
